name: context-gauge
description: Model, context window and 5h/7d usage beside the Claude Code prompt: one quiet line under it in the terminal, a card above it on the desktop.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Terminal line: show the model name. Click it to open the model picker.

showEffort.title: Show the effort
showEffort.description: Terminal line: show the effort level. Click it to open the effort picker.

showWeek.title: Show the 7-day limit
showWeek.description: Terminal line: show how much of the 7-day limit is used.

showResetClock.title: Show the reset's time of day
showResetClock.description: Terminal line: after how long until the 5-hour limit resets, also say at what time.

noticeAt.title: Notice from (%)
noticeAt.description: Terminal line: from this percentage a reading turns from grey to bold, and 5h says when it resets.

alertAt.title: Alert from (%)
alertAt.description: Terminal line: from this percentage a reading turns Claude orange.
